columns.label: Effect
columns.comment: damage values and details sourced from https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WaxvbLx7UoSZaBqdFr1u32F2uWVLo-CJunJB4nlGUE4/edit?gid=1662574278#gid=1662574278

tierLegend.text: game-warping or best-in-class for either damage or roam
alternative chosen based on restrictions or common but not omnipresent
strict downgrades by raw values and fairly niche options
very niche but still finds some usage in rare circumstances
would never be picked for endgame content for any reason

records.name: Eager Edge
records.trigger: sword ready (3s ICD on buff end)
records.effect: 80% (-20% for airborne) increased lunge distance for next swing within 3s
records.description: even outside speedrunning, makes otherwise impossible endgame feats possible

records.name: Attrition Orbs
records.trigger: 55% of mag hit + 2, rounded down (bows: 5, swords: 6, GLs: 4, rockets: 3, area denials: 27, support auto: halved)
records.effect: 0.87% super orb (0.5s ICD)
records.description: strongest orb interaction sandbox, plenty of fast activation methods
records.usage: good on basically everything it touches

records.name: Aggregate Charge
records.trigger: damage to elemental-debuffed target (applies on first shot)
records.description: one of the best fireteam sustained damage perks if Honing annoying

records.name: Repulsor Brace
records.effect: 45 HP Void Overshield for 8-12s
records.description: 150 layered eHP with no ICD and extremely easy requirement, less agency than Heal Clip but better sustain
records.usage: extremely consistent survivability in modern void sandbox

records.name: Elemental Honing
records.effect: 2.5/10/20/30/35% damage (stacks shifted up 1 and 40% highest for kinetics) for 20s, not refreshable with same elements, stowable
records.description: one of the highest consistent sustained perks, especially on kinetics
records.usage: highest sustainable damage perk on kinetics, otherwise still excellent at 35%

records.name: Envious Arsenal
records.trigger: damage with both other equipped weapons, then weapon ready
records.effect: refill
records.description: best reload bypass perk for DPS on 1 mag archetypes
records.usage: essential refill option for rockets and now also crossbows

records.name: One-Two Punch
records.effect: +150% (75% for HC) melee damage for next melee within 3s, removed on stow
records.description: core melee damage perk, helpful on almost every melee build, both roam and DPS
records.usage: very good with almost every melee build, also used for SoF Guile DPS

records.name: Shoot to Loot
records.trigger:
shooting an ammo brick without full ammo
shooting an orb
records.effect:
picks up ammo and refills all weapons
picks up orb
records.description: enables brick setup for damage strategies, also excellent on splash weapons for QoL
records.usage: refill option + ammo for high DPS low total weapons, great for roam in scout encounters

records.name: Physic
records.effect: gives matching ally buff to user
records.description: insane self-sustain in team environments, especially for solar and stasis
records.usage: limited to support auto use case, but almost always essential in said cases

records.name: Withering Gaze
records.effect: next weapon hit applies weaken, reset on hit
records.description: essential for debuff extension without sacrificing exotic slot, great on plenty of weapon types
records.usage: debuff extension on many weapon types

records.name: Heal Clip
records.effect: x2 Cure (x1 to allies within 15m)
records.description: subclass-level sustain effect from one weapon perk, irreplaceable in certain scenarios
records.usage: great controllable heal on rocket sidearms and strong priamries

records.name: Trench Barrel
records.effect: 50% damage, 30 handling, 30 reload for next 3 shots within 5s, removed on stow
records.description: very high damage increase for almost no fire rate drop on certain shotgun archetypes
records.usage: Found Verdict 50% damage perk, also good for increasing total on other shotguns

records.name: Reaper's Tithe
records.effect: 20/30/40% damage for 15s, starts after firing, 6s extensions up to 15s, can't change buff tier
records.description: like Mega Kill Clip but situationally even better for high lethality non-primaries, also usable for boss damage
records.usage: add clear specials and burst rocket damage

records.name: Destabilizing Rounds
records.effect: 7m volatile burst, Volatile Rounds for 3s
records.description: best general splash perk with sandbox synergy, not as strong since artifact provides many alternatives
records.usage: not as necessary given artifact access, but still a guarantee of void synergy

records.name: Kinetic Tremors
records.effect: 3 90 damage kinetic shockwaves under target, incurs 2s ICD after last (effective ~58% on sniper [boss], ~44% on rocket sidearm [miniboss], ~138% on SMG [miniboss])
records.description: one of the best on-hit splash perks, also great for chipping majors, even usable for boss damage
records.usage: DPS sniper swap / miniboss chip, on-hit primary splash

records.name: Chaos Reshaped
records.trigger:
in combat every 5s for 12s
in combat every 5s for 24s
records.effect:
20% damage for 7s, refreshable
35% damage for 7s, 5 HP/s after 7s, stops other healing effects for top 35 HP, stowable, refreshable
records.description: high single target damage buff in sustained combat, healing effect still net positive despite bug
records.usage: great splash pairing on primaries, also usable on DPS weapons

records.name: Cascade Point
records.trigger: readying within 5s or kill or precision hits with another weapon (varies)
records.effect: 0.6x firing delay (0.7x for SMG/LMG) for 2.5s
records.description: ~66.6% DPS increase without any total increase, interesting burst damage option
records.usage: pseudo-double damage perk, needs refill method but high uplift

records.name: Air Trigger
records.effect:
20 ammo generation
30 reload, 0.8x reload duration, -15% accuracy cone, -20% AA cone
records.description: free ammo gen for perk-flexible archetypes, often helpful reload too
records.usage: great for rocket pulses, rocket sidearms, and the like

records.name: Field Prep
records.effect:
20 ammo generation
50 reload, 0.8x reload/ready/stow duration
records.description: basically same as Air Trigger with worse reload condition

records.name: Slice
records.effect: sever on next 5 hits within 8s of each, refreshes timer on non-severed hit, stowable
records.description: excellent artifact synergy, especially great on hunter, can also apply to immunes for Aggregate
records.usage: great on Adamantite, Festival Flight, and strand primaries

records.name: Explosive Payload
records.effect: 15% damage, explosive shot, increased stagger
records.description: pairs great with StL, good instant stagger, applies on-hits twice as fast, interferes with crit perks though
records.usage: stagger, StL synergy, free damage increase, faster on-hits

records.name: Timed Payload
records.effect: 16.5% damage, 0.6s delayed explosive shot, increased stagger
records.description: less common but slightly higher damage EP, would be just as useful except for StL and time-sensitive purposes
records.usage: about as useful as EP for same use cases, slightly higher damage bonus

records.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
records.effect: 2 ammo refund
records.description: effectively doubles total damage and acts as a pseudo-Rewind Rounds, just not on meta archetypes
records.usage: ammo is plentiful enough that double damage is preferred, still good sometimes

records.name: Overflow
records.effect: refill and 100% overflow, stowable
records.description: excellent with Shoot to Loot and other mag increasing perks given brick presence in sandbox
records.usage: burst damage on rockets with StL or other pickup support

records.name: Bipod
records.effect: 1 mag, 5 reserves, 0.75x firing delay, -25% damage, -30 blast radius, -20 reload
records.description: excellent for enabling lethal rocket add clear strategies, also has uses for ammo conversion
records.usage: add clear rocket perk, also for swapping and roam

records.name: All-Star
records.effect: refill and 35% damage for 6s (9s if heavy), 7s extensions up to 10s
records.description: pairs well with Kinetic Synthesis strategies, refill effect useful, otherwise uptime isn't great without setup
records.usage: non-Honing consistent damage for Threat Level, usable for roam

records.name: Auto-Loading Holster
records.effect: refill
records.description: has decent use on perk-flexible archetypes, also usable for super stow interaction
records.usage: 1 mag QoL on weapons like special GLs, also gets use on rockets for super interaction

records.name: Mega Kill Clip
records.effect: 40% damage for (3 + 2 * kills)s, up to 20s, (3 + 2 * kills)s extensions, stowable
records.description: completely eclipses normal Kill Clip, basically just a consistent 40% roam perk, minimum 5s is already enough
records.usage: good on any add clear-focused spree weapon

records.name: Redirection
records.effect: 33% elite+ damage per stack, up to 100% at 3+ stacks, consumes 3 stacks per shot
records.enhancement: -1 stacks consumed, 50% damage per stack instead
records.description: best optimized setup perk, especially on low hit rate weapons in order to conserve stacks
records.usage: technically niche due to setup but by far the best burst perk in the game

records.name: Lead from Gold
records.effect: 25% special ammo, distributed across specials, stowable
records.description: not as important in current ammo sandbox but definitely still useful for ammo pickup loadouts
records.usage: ammo pickup loadouts to completely refill reserves from empty off heavy bricks

records.name: Bait and Switch
records.trigger: damage with all equipped weapons within 7s of each
records.effect: 30% damage for 10s, not refreshable, stowable
records.description: inconsistent application on first shot, easier to activate sustained perk, mostly outclassed
records.usage: basically just weapons that only have it as a consistent sustained option

records.name: High Ground
records.trigger: weapon kill (3 stacks, maxed if damage while grounded 2?m above enemy)
records.effect: 10/17.5/25% damage for 7s, refreshable, stowable
records.description: max damage not that high, but requirements are very easy to meet for spree and sustained
records.usage: A Good Shout damage and occasional LMG alternative perk

records.name: Cluster Bomb
records.effect: 8 clusters on impact, effectively ~25% damage
records.description: free damage perk on quite a few rockets now, not as good as true double damage but still strong
records.usage: double damage option on rockets, especially Hezen

records.name: Lasting Impression
records.effect: 50 blast radius, 3s delayed detonation, 35% explosive damage
records.description: effective ~27% damage, default rocket perk for zero setup scenarios
records.usage: solo rocket damage without Honing access

records.name: Meganeura
records.effect: ~350-500/550-700/600-800 damage 7.5m explosion for 3.5s, refreshable, stowable
records.description: splash perk damage outlier, on-hit to stack, way better than Dragonfly and similar perks
records.usage: paired with elemental 3.0 splash for lethality

records.name: Voltshot
records.effect: next weapon hit within 7s applies jolt, stowable
records.description: great with high reload frequency weapons, jolt is decent splash and more controllable than Jolting Feedback
records.usage: better for high lethality arc weapons vs. Jolting

records.name: Detonator Beam
records.effect: 250 weapon-matching damage 8m explosion on target, effectively ~41.4% damage perk when enhanced
records.description: great for chipping majors, explosion is small so okay for add clear
records.usage: on-hit major chip on traces, also splash against minors

records.name: Jolting Feedback
records.trigger: multiple hits (faster when Amplified) within 3s of each
records.effect: jolt on next hit
records.description: only held back by jolt being sort of mediocre, post-buff application is quite fast in higher-level content
records.usage: standard arc primary go-to especially for harder combat

records.name: Onslaught
records.effect: 20/40/60% fire rate, 15/25/35 reload for 4.5s, refreshable, stowable
records.description: underrated roam pick, speeds up on-hit effect application and on primaries ammo consumption not a concern
records.usage: faster on-hit and massive DPS increase within mag

records.name: Bewildering Burst
records.effect: next hit causes 10m blinding blast above enemy for 3.5s, stowable
records.description: excellent blind uptime on high lethality + easy reload archetypes
records.usage: great on High Albedo, decent on less lethal weapons too

records.name: Headstone
records.effect: medium crystal on kill location (large if T3/4 enemy), 5s ICD after 5 crystals within ?s of first
records.description: great with CODA set + Firefly, also more localized and consistent ~350 damage splash vs. Crystalline
records.usage: basically just to activate CODA with Firefly

records.name: Grave Robber
records.trigger: melee kill or powered melee damage (3s ICD)
records.effect: refill
records.description: best pairing with 12P shotguns that don't have refill origin

records.name: Chain Reaction
records.effect: ~150-300 damage 6m (~350-550 7m for power) elemental explosion
records.description: helps with chaining kills, also applies weapon hit effects due to counting as weapon damage, splash not that high
records.usage: certain GLs and maybe add clear rockets/traces

records.name: Desperate Measures
records.effect:
10% damage for 7s
20-30% damage for 7s, refreshed by weapon/grenade/melee kill, stowable
records.description: very solid and high uptime spree perk, works with almost any build
records.usage: similar use to MoA, slightly higher peak, requires ability kills

records.name: Master of Arms
records.effect: 15% damage for 7s (25% damage for 4s at 2 stacks), layered stacks, refreshable, stowable
records.description: like a better Harmony that does an acceptable amount of damage and is active constantly
records.usage: usable on any weapon, but often on rocket pulses and sidearms

records.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
records.trigger:
weapon kill
weapon kill with Crystalline Corpsebloom
records.effect:
Crystalline Corpsebloom for 4s
~3m random direction seeker that spawns medium crystal
records.description: less direct Headstone option for splashier/body-focused weapons

records.name: Rampage
records.effect: 10/21/33.1% damage for 4.5s, refreshable, layered stacks, stowable
records.description: sort of like Master of Arms with worse uptime when swapping, not terrible on high lethality weapons
records.usage: probably a little better than Killing Tally in the same scenarios

records.name: Explosive Light
records.effect: 25% damage (60% for GL explosive component), stowable, stack consumed on shot
records.description: only use is on Cascade GLs for burst, decent for roam perk swap as well
records.usage: only used for 1 mag GL burst, which is already a little questionable

records.name: Whirlwind Blade
records.effect: 3-30% damage for 3.5s, refreshable, removed on block/stow
records.description: very reliable sustained sword DPS perk, stacks fast with Pack Hunter, just not 100% optimal on meta picks
records.usage: default sword damage perk, others usually require some setup

records.name: Golden Tricorn
records.trigger:
weapon kill
weapon-matched grenade or powered melee kill
records.effect:
15% damage for 7s
50% damage for 10s, refreshable via grenade or powered melee kills
records.description: very potent spree perk if willing to match weapon to main add clear ability
records.usage: even higher than Surrounded for grenade/melee spam builds

records.name: Reciprocity
records.effect: 3 HP per hit
records.description: equivalent to Restoration x1 when holding down trigger (35 HP/s), worse than solar Physic
records.usage: downgrade from Physic on better support autos but still has sustain

records.name: Supercharged Magazine
records.effect:
5% refill every 1.5s
5% refill every 0.25s, up to 2x overflow
records.description: potentially relevant for rockets, otherwise terrible refill rate and Speed Booster requirement means no shooting
records.usage: might enable some Heretic strategies, slower than max rate for best rocket frames

records.name: Impromptu Ammunition
records.effect: 1.15x special progress, 1.1x heavy progress for 5s, 7s extensions
records.description: usually worse than Air Trigger/Field Prep, can still be an alternative
records.usage: only taken on guns that don't have Air Trigger/Field Prep

records.name: Firefly
records.effect: 104 damage 7.5m solar explosion on target, 50 reload for 6s
records.description: useful for triggering CODA set requirements, otherwise lower damage than most splash perks
records.usage: basically just to activate CODA with Headstone

records.name: Gear Shift
records.trigger: kill-reload within ?s or getting Amplified (5 stacks)
records.effect: 15/20/25/30/35% weapon damage for 15s
records.description: solid roam perk for Amplified builds, also potentially usable as an alternative for sustained damage
records.usage: Heretic damage due to bad perk pool, also usable on arc add clear

records.name: Chill Clip
records.effect: x60 (x40 for rapid fusions and rocket sidearms) slow ~4m burst for 4-8s, once per shot
records.description: significantly less useful for stun given modern legendary sandbox, freezing utility not bad though
records.usage: double/triple stun, freezing targets can be helpful

records.name: Relentless Strikes
records.effect: 1 ammo refund
records.description: realistically not that necessary in current ammo sandbox but sometimes helpful for total damage

records.name: Collective Demolition
records.effect: ?% grenade per hit for 4s (8s for firesprites and void breaches), 4-8s extensions up to 16s, stowable
records.description: Bray Legacy-esque interactions for niche grenade spam builds
records.usage: grenade spam DPS/roam builds using Hezen/Apex/fusions/Chivalric

records.name: Focused Fury
records.trigger: 35% mag crits rounded up, counter reset on stow/reload
records.effect: 25% damage for 11s, refreshable, stowable
records.description: surprisingly consistent and easy-to-use precision damage perk, just not high enough to be competitive
records.usage: solid no setup dump precision option

records.name: Impulse Amplifier
records.effect: 20 reload, 0.85x (0.8x on rockets) reload duration, 25% velocity (15% on support autos, 10% on rockets)
records.description: very good reload duration scalar especially for a passive effect, also bypasses velocity cap and high QoL
records.usage: rocket grappling and QoL velocity on micro-missiles, also good reload

records.name: One for All
records.trigger: damage on 3 enemies within 3s of each
records.effect: 35% damage for 10s, not refreshable, stowable
records.description: only really good on weapons that naturally simultaneously hit enemies, otherwise unnatural gameplay loop

records.name: Burning Ambition
records.trigger: next hit after 55% of mag hit, rounded down (some archetypes disobey)
records.effect: 10-15 scorch (20-30 if special/power), 0.5s global CD
records.description: useful for high scorch completion builds, especially for already-scorched effect, some damage utility too
records.usage: good on Acasia's for Hellion builds, otherwise scorch takes too long

records.name: Surrounded
records.effect: 40% (35% for swords and explosive component of rockets/GLs) damage
records.description: getting powercrept from below by perks like Chaos Reshaped and Mega Kill Clip, sometimes good for damage
records.usage: no setup situational shotgun/sword damage perk

records.name: Adhesive Ordnance
records.effect: next shot attaches 6m 766 damage (1044 sniper) exhausting sticky explosive
records.description: okay with Kinetic Synthesis but uptime too low in most cases, like a Recombination on snipers
records.usage: burst perk on weapons like snipers for roam as long as ammo is plentiful

records.name: Killing Tally
records.effect: 10/20/30% damage, not stowable, removed on reload
records.description: return vs. requirement is a little dated, still usable for large mag add clear
records.usage: alternative lower uptime option on LMGs

records.name: Rimestealer
records.trigger: crystal shatter or frozen enemy kill
records.effect: Frost Armor x1
records.description: not bad but Frost Armor is obtainable through artifact, still good on some weapons though
records.usage: some stasis primaries + weapons like Ouster Engine

records.name: Recombination
records.effect: 10-100% damage for first shot, consumes all stacks, stowable
records.description: completely outclassed by Redirection, extremely inefficient stack consumption
records.usage: single shot double damage perk where Redirection isn't available

records.name: Incandescent
records.effect: 30 damage 30-40 scorch ~4m explosion (40-50 over 8m for elite+)
records.enhancement:
5 scorch with Ashes
5 scorch for elite+
records.description: not bad but scorch certainly worse than volatile generally and damage is mediocre
records.usage: sometimes on rocket sidearms/primaries, not that efficient though

records.name: Rewind Rounds
records.effect: refills 60% of hits (14% for adaptive linears) rounded up, counter stowable, minimum of 28.5% hits, counter incurs 1s ICD after refill triggers
records.description: pretty solid on some precision weapons, FTTC is usually better in almost every instance though
records.usage: adaptive linears, fusions, and PK SMGs

records.name: Collective Action
records.effect: 30% damage for 4s (8s for firesprites and void breaches), 4-8s extensions up to 16s, stowable
records.description: usable for sustained damage with trace generation, solid for roam on many pickup-producing builds
records.usage: high uptime roam option for pickup builds

records.name: Demolitionist
records.effect:
10% (20% for fusions, glaives, shotguns, snipers) grenade
refill
records.description: good for grenade returns, seldom used for refill effect now
records.usage: neutral for grenade builds or for getting grenade back in a pinch

records.name: Reconstruction
records.effect: 25% refill, up to 100%, stowable
records.description: way too slow to compete with other refill perks, not even that great for double overflow
records.usage: not bad on LMGs but definitely uncommon now

records.name: Discord
records.trigger:
weapon ready within 5s of other weapon kill
weapon kill with Discord
records.effect:
0.75x ADS duration, -25% accuracy cone, 30 AE for 7s
mag refill (1 ammo refund per shot for special/power)
records.description: unique ammo refund perk, unfortunately not really relevant in current ammo economy
records.usage: one kill-per-shot add clear specials like fusions

records.name: Slideshot
records.effect: 15% refill, 20 range, 20? stability on first shot for 2.5s, removed on stow
records.description: multi refill during slide is interesting for 1 mag weapons, unfortunately still pretty niche

records.name: Slideways
records.effect: 15% refill, 15 stability, 30 handling for 3s, removed on stow
records.description: cannot activate multiple times per slide, generally high QoL refill perks are preferred

records.name: Reservoir Burst
records.effect:
30 mag
30% damage, ~300-750 damage ?m explosion on kill
records.description: full/overflowed requirement is terrible for uptime compared to other standard perks, interesting with Discord
records.usage: only real use is with Discord, otherwise other perks are better for DPS

records.name: Adrenaline Junkie
records.trigger: weapon or grenade kill (5 stacks, grenade gives max)
records.effect: 6.7/13.3/20/26.6/33.3% damage, +20 handling for 4.5s, refreshable, stowable
records.description: underrated roam option given ease of max stack requirement, only problem is duration
records.usage: pairs on almost anything if on grenade build

records.name: Beacon Rounds
records.effect: 15 reload, 0.9x reload duration, 45% tracking cone (stronger with stacks), 4s extensions up to 4s, stowable
records.description: high QoL on rocket pulses, generally unnecessary though
records.usage: QoL tracking on rocket pulses and maybe sidearms

records.name: Ambitious Assassin
records.effect: 20% overflow per kill (10% for special/power, 150% max), rounded up
records.description: especially powerful on 1 mag archetypes, but outclassed even in these scenarios
records.usage: basically only on wave frames since they don't get Clown

records.name: Frenzy
records.effect: 15% damage, 100 handling, 100 reload for 7s, refreshable, stowable
records.description: pretty low for a damage perk, handling and reload are purely QoL in modern sandbox
records.usage: potential usage in 1st column for splash perks/powerful frames

records.name: Under-Over
records.effect: 50% damage to elemental/Barrier shields, 125% damage to overshields
records.description: good for Barrier specialist weapons, otherwise basically useless

records.name: Adaptive Munitions
records.effect: scales to ~50% damage to shields (2-5 hits, weapon-based)
records.description: worse than Under-Over after significant nerfs, still has some use for double shield break combo
records.usage: can be an Under-Over alternative for faster-firing weapons (traces)

records.name: Vorpal Weapon
records.effect: 20% (15% specials, 10% heavies) damage to miniboss+/champs/vehicles
records.description: decent as a second DPS perk but generally not very good even as a passive option
records.usage: Conspiracy Honed double damage, otherwise not very used

records.name: Triple Tap
records.effect: 1 ammo refund, stowable
records.description: half as good as FTTC, generally irrelevant especially in current sandbox
records.usage: taken when no FTTC and no double damage on frames like aggressive snipers

records.name: Hatchling
records.trigger: crit kill or 3 kills within 3s of each
records.effect: threadling spawn
records.description: one of the weaker splash perks, ~350 damage isn't bad but radius is mediocre, has artifact synergy though
records.usage: extra threadlings on add clear strand weapons

records.name: Demoralize
records.effect: 7m weaken burst
records.description: effective splash perk, on the weaker side but still definitely decent with void sandbox
records.usage: might be usable instead of damage perks with Volatile Flow and other options

records.name: Tear
records.effect: ?m severing burst for 10-15s
records.description: very similar in strength to Demoralize, Slice is obviously the better pick overall but definitely usable too
records.usage: non-damaging splash to spread sever for artifact purposes

records.name: Ancillary Ordinance
records.trigger: 3 elemental kills within 4s or elemental-debuffed kill (4 stacks)
records.effect: ~300-400 damage 30m micro-missile launched from next kill (instantly spawns if kinetic elemental-debuffed kill)
records.description: pretty spammable with ability debuffing like Hellion, unravel, etc., but just okay otherwise
records.usage: kinetic option for debuff spam builds, almost always worse than KT though

records.name: Paracausal Affinity
records.effect: 20% damage for 6s, refreshable, stowable
records.description: despite lower damage, probably more usable than Binary Orbit given self-refreshing nature
records.usage: passive no setup damage increase on weapons like traces

records.name: Desperado
records.trigger: crit kill-reload within 5.2s or 3 kills within 3s of each
records.effect: 0.7x firing delay for 6s, refreshable, not stowable
records.description: crit requirement is not great, damage increase is pretty solid though, like an alternative Onslaught
records.usage: fire rate increase on primaries to pair with splash, a little underrated

records.name: Flash Counter
records.effect: 110 weapon-matched damage ~8m disorienting cone blast, counts as weapon damage
records.description: cool defensive utility, usually not that useful, definitely underrated
records.usage: honestly pretty solid for sword neutral

records.name: Box Breathing
records.effect: 40% weakspot damage for first shot (30% for heavy sniper/glaive)
records.description: ADS time requirement for one shot is hard to find a use for
records.usage: first shot burst on some sort pre-planned crit objective or enemy

records.name: Controlled Burst
records.trigger: weapon kill or every bolt hit
records.effect: 20% damage, 0.9x charge for 2s, stowable
records.description: solid DPS increase for fusions, slightly worse than top-tier sustained perks though
records.usage: consistent fusion damage perk when better options aren't available

records.name: Dragonfly
records.effect: ~350-450 damage 8m weapon-matching explosion
records.description: similar damage to Ancillary, just requires crit and no debuff, also small radius
records.usage: alternative to elemental splash on more restricted perk pools

records.name: Clown Cartridge
records.effect: 10% to 50% overflow (rounds up)
records.description: basically only used on rockets and has been replaced by an origin trait
records.usage: DPS rockets that don't have a refill or overflow origin trait

records.name: Archer's Gambit
records.effect: 100? reload, 0.?x reload duration, 0.4x draw time for 4s, 4s extensions up to 8s
records.description: increases bow DPS massively for very little requirement, still fairly niche
records.usage: AO spam bow setups, potentially fast draw neutral

records.name: Explosive Head
records.effect: 15% damage, explosive detonation
records.description: good for counting twice for on-hit purposes, but mostly outclassed
records.usage: still usable for on-hit effects like AO but mostly overtaken by standard splash

records.name: Envious Assassin
records.trigger: weapon ready after other weapon kills
records.effect: 10% (20% special) mag per kill, up to +100% mag per activation (up to +200% total)
records.description: technically the most powerful overflow perk in the game, but worse than Overflow on meta weapons
records.usage: triple mag HGL dump or maybe for special GLs

records.name: Firing Line
records.effect: 20% precision damage
records.description: decent passive damage increase when no other alternative available
records.usage: only used on Conspiracy, otherwise completely outclassed

records.name: Swashbuckler
records.trigger: weapon or melee kill (5 stacks, melee gives max)
